_comment: The Linux host's instances (Oracle A1, Ubuntu). Same schema as deploy/instances.json; read by apache_supervisor.py started from deploy/apache/oracle-stack.conf. Loopback HTTP only: Apache holds TLS at the front (oracle-front.conf). Instances are added here as each is proven on Linux. meowdoku-a runs --no-wasm: the fountains' wasm fallback compile (zig clang -O2 on fountain_small.ll) peaked at ~22 GB and the OOM killer fired twice on the 24 GB Oracle A1 host (2026-11-21); the GPU products are built, the wasm fallback is not.
